name: trie-ide
description: Coding agent: local GGUF via embedded trie-daemon, or any LLM API (Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI, Kimi, and other cloud endpoints). Hybrid mode adds sparing frontier-model guidance.

enumDescriptions: Trie IDE daemon (embedded or external) serving local GGUF models over localhost.
Any LLM API — local (Ollama, LM Studio, llama-server) or cloud (OpenAI, Kimi, etc.). Uses a standard /v1/chat/completions endpoint.
trie-ide.backend.description: Which inference backend drives the agent loop.

trie-ide.daemon.url.description: Base URL of the Trie IDE daemon (trie-daemon).

trie-ide.daemon.autoStart.description: When backend is daemon, start the embedded trie-daemon if none is reachable at trie-ide.daemon.url.

trie-ide.daemon.keepRunning.description: Leave the embedded trie-daemon running after VS Code closes (server mode for other clients).

trie-ide.daemon.command.description: Advanced: shell command to start an external trie-daemon (empty = use embedded daemon bundled in this extension).

trie-ide.daemon.storePath.description: Model store volume path on the daemon host (empty = daemon's home directory).

trie-ide.daemon.contextLength.description: Context length to load local models with.

trie-ide.api.baseUrl.description: Base URL of your LLM API — local (Ollama, LM Studio, llama-server) or cloud (OpenAI, Kimi, etc.).

trie-ide.api.modelName.description: Model id on that API (e.g. qwen2.5-coder:7b, gpt-4o-mini).

trie-ide.api.apiKey.description: Bearer token for cloud APIs; optional for local servers.

trie-ide.agent.maxToolCalls.description: Maximum tool calls per agent turn. 0 means unlimited; the turn deadline still applies.

trie-ide.agent.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for the agent model.

trie-ide.agent.profile.description: Permission posture preset for the coding agent.

trie-ide.agent.budgets.modeDeadlineCodeM.description: End-to-end turn deadline for Code mode (milliseconds).

trie-ide.agent.budgets.modeDeadlinePlanM.description: End-to-end turn deadline for Plan mode (milliseconds).

trie-ide.agent.budgets.modeDeadlineAskMs.description: End-to-end turn deadline for Ask mode (milliseconds).

trie-ide.agent.budgets.modeGenerationsPl.description: Local model generation budget for Plan mode tool loops.

trie-ide.agent.budgets.modeGenerationsAs.description: Local model generation budget for Ask mode tool loops.

trie-ide.agent.budgets.maxCompactionGene.description: Separate budget for memory-compaction summarizer calls (does not consume tool-loop generations).

trie-ide.agent.budgets.recommendationGen.description: Local generation budget for recommendation-ask finish paths.

trie-ide.agent.budgets.recommendationExp.description: Exploration tool calls before recommendation synthesis is forced.
Exploration wall-clock budget before recommendation synthesis (milliseconds).

trie-ide.agent.budgets.frontierConsultLi.description: Hybrid mode: advisory consult calls per turn (stuck hints, final review).

trie-ide.agent.budgets.frontierCompletio.description: Hybrid mode: completion calls per turn (judge, rewrite, decompose).

trie-ide.agent.budgets.reservedFinishMs.description: Milliseconds reserved at turn deadline for finish/judge/review phases.

trie-ide.frontierAssist.enabled.markdownDescription: **Hybrid mode** — consult a frontier (cloud) model for advisory guide notes when the local model is stuck or finishes a turn. The frontier model never drives the tool loop and never edits files. Use the **Settings** button in the sidebar or **Trie Coding Agent: Configure Hybrid Mode**.

trie-ide.frontierAssist.activeSlot.description: Hybrid mode: which provider slot (0–2) is active in chat.

trie-ide.frontierAssist.slots.markdownDescription: Hybrid mode: up to 3 provider slots. Each slot has `provider`, `apiKey`, up to 3 `models`, and `activeModel` (0–2).

trie-ide.frontierAssist.provider.deprecationMessage: Use frontierAssist.slots instead. Kept for migration from older versions.
trie-ide.frontierAssist.provider.description: Hybrid mode: legacy single provider (migrated to slot 0 on read).

trie-ide.frontierAssist.model.deprecationMessage: Use frontierAssist.slots instead. Kept for migration from older versions.
trie-ide.frontierAssist.model.description: Hybrid mode: legacy model name (migrated to slot 0 on read).

trie-ide.frontierAssist.apiKey.deprecationMessage: Use frontierAssist.slots instead. Kept for migration from older versions.
trie-ide.frontierAssist.apiKey.markdownDescription: Hybrid mode: legacy API key (migrated to slot 0 on read).

enumDescriptions: Web search disabled — the web_search tool is not offered to the agent.
Tavily (tavily.com) — search API built for AI agents.
Ceramic (ceramic.ai) — low-cost web search API for LLMs.
trie-ide.webSearch.provider.markdownDescription: **Web search** — give the agent a `web_search` tool. Requests go directly from your machine to the provider using your API key; nothing is proxied through Trie.

trie-ide.webSearch.apiKey.markdownDescription: Web search: API key for the selected provider. Required for the `web_search` tool to appear.

trie-ide.webSearch.maxResults.description: Web search: maximum results per query (1–10).

trie-ide.index.enabled.markdownDescription: **Codebase indexing** — maintain a prefix-trie symbol index of your workspace so the agent answers "where is X declared" in milliseconds instead of scanning every file. Runs entirely on your machine; nothing leaves it.

trie-ide.index.onStartup.description: Codebase indexing: build the index automatically when the workspace opens (recommended). Turn off to defer until the agent’s first symbol search.

trie-ide.index.maxResults.description: Codebase indexing: maximum declarations returned per symbol search (5–100).

trie-ide.index.scoreThreshold.markdownDescription: Codebase indexing: minimum match score (0–1) for `search_symbols` results. Scores are lexical and explainable — 1.0 exact, ~0.75–0.95 prefix, ~0.65 word initials, ~0.5–0.65 substring, ~0.3–0.7 multi-word subword coverage, ~0.35–0.5 typo-tolerant. Raise for exact-ish matches only; lower to allow fuzzier hits.
